tooltip.hydemod.ted_microphone: Lets you speak to the unwashed masses. Right-click: deliver a 2070 prediction.
tooltip.hydemod.pat_on_the_back: That pat on the back is for saving the world. Heals you and nearby players.
tooltip.hydemod.mind_upload_blackberry: Sneak + use: upload your mind. Use: download it back (teleport).
tooltip.hydemod.reset_the_clock: "Can we reset the clock so I have another minute?" Sets the time to morning.
tooltip.hydemod.maglev_moon_launcher: Maglev trains to get resources to the Moon. You are the resource.
tooltip.hydemod.einstein: A parable about a second-tier college. You'll never guess who the student was.
tooltip.hydemod.tedx_invitation: Summon Sam Hyde on open ground. Watch attack warnings; interrupt his healing.
tooltip.hydemod.elephant_fruit: Eat it: Strength II and Speed II for one hour. Dropped by Elephant Mario.
tooltip.hydemod.giant_goobers_box: Summon Elephant Mario on open ground. Jump his waves and sidestep his charge.
tooltip.hydemod.pipe_wrench: Click two pipes to link them across dimensions. Sneak-click a pipe to unlink.
tooltip.hydemod.pipe_wrench.pending: First pipe: %s %s %s - now click the second pipe
message.hydemod.station.charged: +%s RF -> saber now %s RF (station: %s RF left)
message.hydemod.socks_blown_off: That Sea Cheesy Baked Potato blew your socks off. (And your boots.)
message.hydemod.pat_on_the_back: Pat yourself on the back. That one's for saving the world.
message.hydemod.blackberry.downloaded: Mind downloaded. You feel cryogenically refreshed.
message.hydemod.blackberry.empty: No mind uploaded yet. Sneak + use to upload.
message.hydemod.reset_clock: %s asked them to reset the clock. It's morning again.
message.hydemod.reset_clock.fail: There's no clock to reset in this dimension.
message.hydemod.wrench.first: Pipe selected at %s %s %s. Now right-click the pipe to link it to.
message.hydemod.wrench.linked: Warp pipes linked! Stand on one and sneak to travel.
message.hydemod.wrench.missing: The other warp pipe is gone.
message.hydemod.warp_pipe.unlinked: This warp pipe isn't linked. Use a Pipe Wrench on two pipes.
message.hydemod.warp_pipe.linked: Linked to %s %s %s (%s). Hold sneak to warp; sneak-click with an empty hand to change the exit.
message.hydemod.sam_hyde_summoned: Please welcome the final speaker of the final session: SAM HYDE. 2070 PARADIGM SHIFT.
message.hydemod.elephant_mario_summoned: The ground trembles. Somewhere, an elephant puts on a cap. ELEPHANT MARIO has arrived!
chat.hydemod.speaker: <%s> %s
message.hydemod.boss_peaceful: Bosses can't be summoned on Peaceful difficulty.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.intro: I'm Sam Hyde. I'm an important thinker.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.reset_clock: Can we reset the clock so I have another minute extra?
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.trash: Trash economy. You use cubes of trash as money. Everybody becomes rich. It's a gold rush.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.close_eyes: Close your eyes. Everybody in this room, close your eyes.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.grovlers: Depth grovlers will live underground in tiered cities.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.maglev: Use maglev trains to get resources to the Moon.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.coffee: You're drinking Bulletproof Coffee and you don't even realize you're getting all jagged up in the head.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.pat: Guys, pat yourselves on the back right now.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.trash_rain: Trash economy. The abundance of trash.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.hurt.4: Is this anybody's? I'm claiming that there, right.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.hurt.5: You did good in school. I didn't do that good.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.taunt.1: What inspires you? What inspires you?
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.taunt.3: Look at us. We're the machine that keeps the world going.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.taunt.4: By my calculations, we have five years until the world ends.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.taunt.5: Have you ever had sea cheesy baked potatoes? That'll blow your socks off.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.taunt.6: Video games are going to get more realistic.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.taunt.7: Fuel efficient vehicles getting eighty, a hundred miles per gallon. It's not that crazy.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.taunt.8: I'm going to have your mind uploaded to my, my BlackBerry.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.taunt.9: You'll be cryogenically frozen. I know it.
boss.hydemod.sam_hyde.taunt.10: There's no more individual anymore. It's just the hive.
prediction.hydemod.1: 2070: Sea floor farming! Sea beets, sea yams, sea cabbage!
prediction.hydemod.2: 2070: Cubes of trash are money. Everybody becomes rich.
prediction.hydemod.3: 2070: Vast pleasure domes for the elites. The rest of you toil underground for nuggets of neoplas.
prediction.hydemod.4: 2070: Video games are going to get more realistic.
prediction.hydemod.5: 2070: Super fuel-efficient vehicles - 80, 100 miles per gallon!
prediction.hydemod.6: 2070: Flip side of that coin - gas is ten dollars a gallon.
prediction.hydemod.7: 2070: You can't win them all, but we'll have solar power.
prediction.hydemod.9: 2070: SodaStream does for soda what 3D printing did for... everything.
prediction.hydemod.11: 2070: iPads built into every school desk.
prediction.hydemod.12: 2070: Your mind is uploaded to a BlackBerry.
prediction.hydemod.13: 2070: Fifty billion people, and robots to bridge the gap.
quote.hydemod.einstein.1: I was at a college - a second-tier college. Not an Ivy. A second-choice school.
quote.hydemod.einstein.2: The teacher was spouting nonsense, and nobody dared speak up. Except one student.
quote.hydemod.einstein.3: He had logic on his side, and in the end he proved his point.
boss.hydemod.elephant_mario.intro: *TRUMPET* Who ate my fruit?! Somebody is getting stomped.
tooltip.hydemod.trash_cube: Currency of the 2070 trash economy. Also throwable.
tooltip.hydemod.neoplas_nugget: The depth grovlers toil endlessly for these.
tooltip.hydemod.peanut: Found in tall grass. Coat it in chocolate.
tooltip.hydemod.paradigm_shift_core: A whole paradigm, shifted. Dropped by Sam Hyde.
tooltip.hydemod.sea_cheesy_baked_potato: Will blow your socks off. Literally.
tooltip.hydemod.bulletproof_coffee: Gets you all jagged up in the head.
tooltip.hydemod.soda_stream: Craft with a water bottle and sugar to make soda. Not used up.
tooltip.hydemod.hyde_chestplate: Full set: Strength, Resistance, Fire Resistance, Night Vision.
tooltip.hydemod.lightsaber_hilt: Combine with a kyber crystal to build a lightsaber.
tooltip.hydemod.turkish_delight: Enchanted sweets from a land of endless winter. Once you start...
tooltip.hydemod.healing_cordial: One drop heals any wound. Use on yourself, or right-click another creature.
tooltip.hydemod.stone_spell_wand: The Winter Witch's wand: turns a creature to stone and freezes the water around it.
tooltip.hydemod.wizard_wand: Sneak + use to change spell. Use to cast.
tooltip.hydemod.invisibility_cloak: Throw it over yourself to vanish for a minute.
tooltip.hydemod.flying_broom: Hold right-click to fly where you look.
tooltip.hydemod.butterscotch_brew: Warm, frothy and sweet. Warms you right through.
tooltip.hydemod.power_mushroom: Makes you grow huge for a minute: more health, more reach.
tooltip.hydemod.invincibility_star: Twelve seconds of invincibility. Anything hostile you touch goes flying.
tooltip.hydemod.heart_vessel: Permanently adds one heart (up to ten extra).
tooltip.hydemod.grappling_hook: Fires a chain at a block and yanks you to it.
tooltip.hydemod.bomb: Light it and throw it. Bounces once, then BOOM.
tooltip.hydemod.ocarina: Play the tune to swap day and night.
tooltip.hydemod.ring_of_unseeing: Hold it to vanish from sight and slip away from monsters. It gnaws at you.
tooltip.hydemod.elven_blade: Glows blue when monsters are near.
tooltip.hydemod.mithril_mail: Light as a feather, hard as dragon scales.
tooltip.hydemod.elven_waybread: One bite fills a grown man's stomach.
tooltip.hydemod.star_phial: A light for dark places. Blinds and scatters nearby monsters.
message.hydemod.heart_vessel: Your heart grows stronger! (+%s extra hearts)
message.hydemod.heart_vessel.max: Your heart can't grow any stronger.
message.hydemod.ocarina.day: The sun rises to your tune.
call.hydemod.elephant_mario.name: Elephant Mario
tooltip.hydemod.slugger_bat: A trusty baseball bat. Sometimes you hit a home run. SMAAAASH!
tooltip.hydemod.reflector_badge: Keep it anywhere in your inventory: half of projectile damage bounces back at the shooter.
tooltip.hydemod.healing_butterfly: Let it go: heals you fully and shakes off poison and weakness.
tooltip.hydemod.spin_hammer: Slam the ground: a shockwave flips everything nearby into the air.
tooltip.hydemod.flip_charm: Flip between dimensions to slip through up to 3 blocks of wall.
tooltip.hydemod.moment_stopwatch: Stops time for everything around you for five seconds.
tooltip.hydemod.chrono_pendant: Keep it with you: a fatal blow rewinds you 10 seconds instead (once every 5 minutes).
message.hydemod.chrono_rewind: Time rewinds... you get a second chance.
message.hydemod.warp_pipe.blocked: Exit blocked! Clear space above the destination pipe, then release sneak to retry.
message.hydemod.warp_pipe.arrived: Here we go! Release sneak before your next warp.
message.hydemod.wrench.unlinked: Pipe unlinked. Click two pipes to create a new route.

tooltip.hydemod.day_today_press_pass: Use on clear ground for Peter; sneak-use for Chris. Reusable. One of each nearby in survival.
tooltip.hydemod.stretched_twig_of_peace: Use: Weakness and Slowness for hostiles within 10 blocks, for 8s. Cooldown 15s; wears twice as fast in the Nether.
tooltip.hydemod.satellite_infomometer: Use for your coordinates, dimension, weather and hostile count within 32 blocks.
tooltip.hydemod.news_microphone: Use to broadcast your position to players within 32 blocks. Cooldown 10s.
tooltip.hydemod.fact_bomb: Use to reveal hostiles within 16 blocks for 10s. Consumed. Flash and particles; no blast damage.
tooltip.hydemod.this_is_our_war: A souvenir VHS from an overexcited newsroom. Use to read its original archive synopsis.
tooltip.hydemod.unverified_report: Obtained by giving paper to a reporter. Use to read a very doubtful field report.
message.hydemod.news.no_room: The outside broadcast needs clear, dry ground and room for a reporter.
message.hydemod.news.already_here: That correspondent is already covering this area. Speak to them first.
message.hydemod.news.arrival: %s has arrived for the outside broadcast.
message.hydemod.news.editor: Chris: A report on paper. Excellent. The newsroom still requires evidence.
message.hydemod.news.copy: Peter: My field report. The figures are provisional, as is my location.
message.hydemod.news.twig_response: The twig has brought a welcome pause to the interview. The studio is checking its structural integrity.
message.hydemod.news.peter.0: Peter: I can confirm this area contains at least forty creepers. I have counted none of them personally.
message.hydemod.news.peter.1: Peter: The local emerald quota is thirty percent. My calculator has requested a taxi.
message.hydemod.news.peter.2: Peter: I am reporting from the scene. The scene may be behind me. Or in another dimension.
message.hydemod.news.peter.3: Peter: Every villager supports my findings. I conducted the interviews in fluent doorbell.
message.hydemod.news.chris.0: Chris: Before we go live, establish three things: the place, the number, and whether Peter is actually there.
message.hydemod.news.chris.1: Chris: Our satellite instruments show weather. The newsroom has classified it as an exclusive.
message.hydemod.news.chris.2: Chris: Keep the microphone pointed at the interviewee. The ground has already declined to comment.
message.hydemod.news.chris.3: Chris: We have prepared an emergency bulletin for an event which has yet to agree to happen.
message.hydemod.news.correction: Chris: Peter, the infomometer is beside you. Please measure something before giving it a number.
message.hydemod.news.peace: The twig lowers the temperature of the debate: %s hostiles weakened and slowed.
message.hydemod.news.melting: The twig is at melting point: %s hostiles weakened and slowed. Two durability used.
message.hydemod.news.reading: Infomometer: X %s / Y %s / Z %s | %s | %s hostiles within 32 blocks.
message.hydemod.news.clear: Weather desk: clear skies. The emergency graphic will have to wait.
message.hydemod.news.rain: Weather desk: rain. The outside broadcast has misplaced its umbrella.
message.hydemod.news.thunder: Weather desk: thunder. The newsroom has put a tie on the lightning.
message.hydemod.news.live: The Day Today: %s reports live from X %s, Z %s. Facts subject to verification.
message.hydemod.news.fact_bomb: Fact Bomb: the camera flash exposes nearby hostiles. No terrain was harmed in this bulletin.
message.hydemod.news.archive: Archive synopsis: a presenter inflates a diplomatic dispute into a broadcast spectacle, then packages the coverage as a souvenir. Original game text; no programme recording is included.
message.hydemod.news.unverified: FIELD REPORT: Thirty percent of local creepers reject the new emerald quota. Source: a man who mistook a furnace for a finance minister. Status: entirely unverified.
